mapping_policy: A label is evaluable only when its anatomical identity has a direct broad counterpart in the frozen 13-state root vocabulary. Developmental subtypes may be collapsed to their documented parent identity; unmatched or non-isomorphic identities are retained as non-comparable, not recoded as correct or unknown.

cortical aerenchyma.rationale: Specialized cortex derivative; evaluated at the frozen model's parent cortex resolution.

cortical sclerenchyma.rationale: Cortical derivative; evaluated at the frozen model's parent cortex resolution.

early-cortex.rationale: Early cortex state; evaluated at parent cortex resolution.

early-stele.rationale: Stele precursor state; evaluated at parent stele resolution.

elongating-endodermis.rationale: Endodermal differentiation state; evaluated at parent endodermis resolution.

elongating-xylem.rationale: Xylem differentiation state; evaluated at parent xylem resolution.

lignified-endodermis.rationale: Endodermal differentiation state; evaluated at parent endodermis resolution.

lignified-xylem.rationale: Xylem differentiation state; evaluated at parent xylem resolution.

mature-endodermis.rationale: Endodermal maturation state; evaluated at parent endodermis resolution.

mature-xylem.rationale: Xylem maturation state; evaluated at parent xylem resolution.

pericycle.rationale: Pericycle is a stele identity and the frozen vocabulary has no separate pericycle class.

phloem/SE.rationale: Sieve-element phloem subtype; evaluated at parent phloem resolution.

procambium.rationale: Provascular stele precursor; evaluated at parent stele resolution.

senescent cortex.rationale: Cortex state; evaluated at parent cortex resolution.

crown root initials.rationale: No root-initiation counterpart exists in the frozen vocabulary.

dividing cells.rationale: The broad cycling label is not equivalent to the frozen G1/G0 or S-phase states.

early-epidermis.rationale: The early epidermal state cannot be assigned uniquely to trichoblast or atrichoblast.

exodermis.rationale: Exodermis is not interchangeable with endodermis.

meristem.rationale: Meristem identity has no direct frozen output label.

sclerenchyma.rationale: Sclerenchyma is not equivalent to a frozen cortex state.

claim_boundary: This is a coarse cross-species ontology contract for the frozen external audit only. It neither trains the model nor converts non-comparable author states into apparent successes.
